title: Ten-sided polynomial decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 2, 3, 4) and budget 4

claims.statement: The explicit four-component 2000-use polynomial-tag decoder with rank costs (0, 1, 2, 3, 4) and a per-group cost cap of 4 has uniform-message average block error at most 977285287765207393/1000000000000000000 on BSC(1/10).
The same fixed bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes exactly W=4322536 primitives on every input, with W<=2^(440869/20000).

experiments.purpose: Verify local spectra and exact pair overlap profiles, including both distance cutoffs for support six through nine. The fourth run also checks the exact error and RAM counts.
